When `patch` tries to process the second file in the diff, it won't find it and will fail. The same issue exists in `get_fixed_code_direct` where I'm only extracting and using the first file from the changed files list. I need to copy all the changed files into the temp directory before applying the full patch. the patch, then return the content of the specific file I care about (changed_files[0])

Actually, for the purpose of `get_fixed_code_direct`, we just need the fixed version of the main changed file. So option 1 is simpler and more robust: copy all changed files to temp dir, apply full patch, read back the target file.

But `get_fixed_code_direct` returns a single file's content. For multi-file patches, which file should it return? The current code uses `changed_files[0]`. The simplest approach is to modify `get_fixed_code_direct` to copy all the changed files into the temp directory before applying the patch, which ensures the patch succeeds regardless of how many files it touches.
